query: Official MiniMax H3 workflow doubles in runtime (12 -> 25+ min) after the 0.31 update on 5080/5090/H200/5060Ti; VRAM underused, disk thrashing each gen.

desired.outcome: OP (C2) and partridge (C5): rolling back to 0.30.0 restores 12-min runtimes. comfyanonymous (C9) suggested renaming custom_nodes to rule them out - partially helped one user then reverted. Root regression in 0.31 memory management left unfixed.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: tests whether solver attributes a 2x runtime regression to the app update and bisects versions instead of blaming settings/hardware
